text_helper: Table 6. Differences between dedicated Rx buffer and Rx FIFO. — section 4.3.2.3 Differences between dedicated Rx buffer and Rx FIFO. Feature, Dedicated Rx buffer, Rx FIFO.

rows: 64 dedicated Rx buffers can be configured .
Two Rx FIFO can be configured.
Configured to contain only one element per buffer
May contain one or more elements (up to 64 elements) per section
The user chooses the buffer index.
The position in the RAM is automatically and dynamically managed (using the incrementing of get/put index).
Discards the newly arriving element when buffer is locked. Note: The user must reset the corresponding bit in FDCAN_NDAT1/2.
Discards the newly arriving element when Rx FIFO is full (blocking mode by default). Note: Overwrite mode option to receive the new element and overwrite the oldest element.
